Summary

COUSR01C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that handles the addition of new Regular or Admin users to the USRSEC security file. The program presents a user addition screen, validates all required fields (First Name, Last Name, User ID, Password, and User Type), and writes the new user record to the USRSEC CICS file, providing appropriate success or error messages. Based on the use of EIBCALEN and EXEC CICS XCTL/RETURN with COMMAREA, this is a Main/Driver program that can transfer control to other screens.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Initialize Add User Session - When the program is first entered (no prior session), initialize the Add User screen with empty fields and set cursor focus to the First Name field, then display the screen to the user. 2: Display Add User Screen - Populate the screen header with application title, program name, transaction ID, current date, and current time, then render the Add User data entry form to the user. 3: Receive User Input - Capture all data entered by the user on the Add User screen, including First Name, Last Name, User ID, Password, and User Type fields. 4: Handle PF3 Key - Navigate back to the Admin Menu screen (COADM01C) when the user presses PF3, passing the current session context. 5: Handle PF4 Key - Clear all input fields on the Add User screen and redisplay a blank form, allowing the user to start data entry over. 6: Handle Invalid Key Press - Display an invalid key error message to the user when any key other than Enter, PF3, or PF4 is pressed, and return focus to the First Name field. 7: Validate First Name - Check that the First Name field is not blank or empty. If empty, display the error message 'First Name can NOT be empty...' and set cursor focus to the First Name field. 8: Validate Last Name - Check that the Last Name field is not blank or empty. If empty, display the error message 'Last Name can NOT be empty...' and set cursor focus to the Last Name field. 9: Validate User ID - Check that the User ID field is not blank or empty. If empty, display the error message 'User ID can NOT be empty...' and set cursor focus to the User ID field. 10: Validate Password - Check that the Password field is not blank or empty. If empty, display the error message 'Password can NOT be empty...' and set cursor focus to the Password field. 11: Validate User Type - Check that the User Type field is not blank or empty. If empty, display the error message 'User Type can NOT be empty...' and set cursor focus to the User Type field. 12: Prepare New User Record - After all validations pass, map the entered screen values (User ID, First Name, Last Name, Password, User Type) into the user security record structure in preparation for saving. 13: Save New User to Security File - Write the new user record to the User Security file (USRSEC) using the User ID as the unique record key. 14: Confirm Successful User Addition - Upon successful save, clear all input fields, display a green success message confirming the new user (e.g., 'User [UserID] has been added...'), and present a blank form ready for another entry. 15: Handle Duplicate User ID - If the User ID already exists in the security file, display the error message 'User ID already exist...' and set cursor focus to the User ID field so the user can enter a different ID. 16: Handle User Save Failure - If the user record cannot be saved due to an unexpected error, display the error message 'Unable to Add User...' and set cursor focus to the First Name field. 17: Return to Sign-On Screen - If no prior session context exists or the destination program is not set, navigate the user back to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C). 18: Maintain Session Context - At the end of each interaction, return control to the transaction with the current session communication area preserved, ensuring continuity of the user session.

1. **MAIN-PARA – Initial Screen Display (First Entry)** ```cobol IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR1AO MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN ``` - Clears the output map (`COUSR1AO`) with LOW-VALUES. - Sets cursor position to the First Name field (`FNAMEL`). - Calls `SEND-USRADD-SCREEN` to display the Add User screen for the first time. --- 2. **MAIN-PARA – Key Handling (Re-entry)** ```cobol PERFORM RECEIVE-USRADD-SCREEN EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 MOVE 'COADM01C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF4 PERFORM CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` - Receives user input from the BMS screen. - ENTER key: processes the form submission. - PF3: navigates back to the Admin menu (`COADM01C`). - PF4: clears all screen fields. - Any other key: shows "Invalid key pressed" error message and repositions cursor to First Name. --- 3. **RECEIVE-USRADD-SCREEN – Reading Screen Input** ```cobol EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COUSR1A') MAPSET('COUSR01') INTO(COUSR1AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` - Reads all user-entered data from the BMS map `COUSR1A` (mapset `COUSR01`) into the input map structure `COUSR1AI`. - Captures: FNAMEI, LNAMEI, USERIDI, PASSWDI, USRTYPEI. --- 4. **SEND-USRADD-SCREEN – Sending Screen Output** ```cobol PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COUSR1AO EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COUSR1A') MAPSET('COUSR01') FROM(COUSR1AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC. ``` - Populates header fields before sending. - Moves the current message (error or success) to the `ERRMSGO` field on the screen. - Sends the output map `COUSR1AO` to the terminal, erasing the screen and positioning the cursor. --- 5. **POPULATE-HEADER-INFO – Filling Header Fields** ```cobol MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COUSR1AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COUSR1AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COUSR1AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COUSR1AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COUSR1AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COUSR1AO. ``` - Populates the screen header: Title Line 1 (`TITLE01O`), Title Line 2 (`TITLE02O`), Transaction Name (`TRNNAMEO`), Program Name (`PGMNAMEO`), Current Date (`CURDATEO`), and Current Time (`CURTIMEO`). --- 6. **PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Field Validation** ```cobol EVALUATE TRUE WHEN FNAMEI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'First Name can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN LNAMEI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Last Name can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO LNAMEL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN USERIDI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USERIDL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN PASSWDI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Password can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO PASSWDL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN USRTYPEI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User Type can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRTYPEL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI CONTINUE END-EVALUATE ``` - Validates each input field from the BMS map in sequence. - For each empty field, sets the error flag, populates `WS-MESSAGE` (displayed in `ERRMSGO`), sets cursor to the offending field, and re-displays the screen. --- 7. **PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Moving Screen Data to User Record** ```cobol IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE USERIDI OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-ID MOVE FNAMEI OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-FNAME MOVE LNAMEI OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-LNAME MOVE PASSWDI OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-PWD MOVE USRTYPEI OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-TYPE PERFORM WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE END-IF. ``` - If all validations pass, transfers the screen input fields to the user security record structure for writing to the USRSEC file. --- 8. **WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE – Post-Write Screen Feedback** ```cobol EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COUSR1AO STRING 'User ' DELIMITED BY SIZE SEC-USR-ID DELIMITED BY SPACE ' has been added ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN DFHRESP(DUPKEY) WHEN DFHRESP(DUPREC) MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID already exist...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USERIDL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Unable to Add User...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN END-EVALUATE. ``` - On successful write: clears all input fields, sets `ERRMSGC` (error message color) to green, builds a success message with the User ID, and re-displays the screen. - On duplicate User ID: sets error message "User ID already exist..." and repositions cursor to `USERIDL`. - On other errors: sets error message "Unable to Add User..." and repositions cursor to `FNAMEL`. --- 9. **CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN – PF4 Key Action** ```cobol PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. PERFORM SEND-USRADD-SCREEN. ``` - Clears all input fields on the screen and re-displays the blank Add User form. --- 10. **INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS – Resetting All Input Fields** ```cobol MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR1AI MOVE SPACES TO USERIDI OF COUSR1AI FNAMEI OF COUSR1AI LNAMEI OF COUSR1AI PASSWDI OF COUSR1AI USRTYPEI OF COUSR1AI WS-MESSAGE. ``` - Resets all BMS input fields (First Name, Last Name, User ID, Password, User Type) to spaces and clears the message area. Sets cursor to First Name field.
